children: U.S. biotech firm's Q3 revenue fell 11% yr/yr but beat analyst expectations
Q3 adjusted EBITDA beat analyst expectations
Company achieved total profitability ahead of plan
Adaptive Biotechnologies raises 2026 MRD revenue guidance to $276 mln-$286 mln
Company expects 2026 operating expenses to be about $350 mln, down from prior $350 mln-$355 mln
Company says new multiple myeloma guidelines expected to drive demand for MRD testing
MRD GROWTH - Co said core MRD revenue rose 44% yr/yr excluding milestones, supporting overall results
clonoSEQ TEST VOLUME - Co reported 46% yr/yr increase in clonoSEQ test volume in Q3
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Adaptive Biotechnologies Corporation is $31.00, about 20.2% above its November 3 closing price of $25.80
